about.default_about_text: MedPortal is a leading provider of medical supplies, surgical instruments, and healthcare solutions in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East.
about.default_vision: To be the premier trusted partner in healthcare supply chain, delivering surgical precision and medical excellence to every operating theatre and clinic.
about.default_mission: To equip healthcare professionals with certified, high-grade medical supplies and surgical tools that elevate patient care and clinical outcomes.
about.quality_text: We adhere to the highest international standards. Every product undergoes rigorous testing and quality control before reaching our clients.
about.sfda_text: Fully compliant and registered with the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), ensuring safety and reliability in all medical supplies.
about.purpose_subtitle: The principles that guide everything we do.
about.why_choose_us_subtitle: Four pillars that define our service to the healthcare community.
about.value1_text: Founded by the Mehr family in 1942, our manufacturing lineage spans three generations of precision surgical craft, exporting worldwide with an unblemished reputation.
about.value2_text: Our specialized production units exclusively employ the highest quality medical-grade stainless steel and optical components imported from Germany, France, Japan, and Pakistan.
about.value3_text: Certified under ISO 9001:2008, ISO 13485:2003, ISO 7376 Green Spec, CE Certificate, cGMP, and fully registered with the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA).
about.value4_text: Direct distribution across Saudi Arabia (+966 55 928 6613) providing hospitals, day surgery centers, and clinics with express fulfillment and specialist support.
about.legal_subtitle: Our registration and certification details for healthcare procurement teams.

contact.form_subtitle: Fill out the details below and our team will get back to you within 2 business hours.
contact.urgent_text: For immediate emergency theatre supplies or urgent instrument replacements across KSA, call our direct logistics hot desk.
contact.sfda_desk_text: Need batch analysis certificates, ISO documentation, or SFDA registration letters for procurement records?
contact.faq_subtitle: Common questions regarding ordering, SFDA certificates, and logistics across Saudi Arabia.
contact.faq1_q: What is your standard delivery timeframe within Saudi Arabia?
contact.faq1_a: We offer express delivery within 24 to 48 hours to major hubs including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Mecca, and Medina. Regional clinic shipments typically arrive within 2–3 business days.
contact.faq2_q: Are all products certified and registered with the SFDA?
contact.faq2_a: Yes. 100% of surgical instruments, sets, and medical consumables cataloged on MedPortal are registered with the Saudi Food & Drug Authority (SFDA) and comply with ISO standards.
contact.faq3_q: Can hospitals and healthcare institutions request formal RFP quotes?
contact.faq3_a: Absolutely. Our sales department handles volume pricing, formal quotation sheets, and credit terms for licensed hospitals, day-surgery centers, and medical chains.
contact.faq4_q: What is your warranty and return policy for surgical instruments?
contact.faq4_a: Our surgical grade instruments come with a lifetime material guarantee against manufacturing defects. If an item arrives compromised or fails inspection, we issue an immediate replacement.
